description: Implementation of executor metrics channel for collecting and aggregating task execution metrics in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: executor_metrics_channel
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting, updating, and reporting execution metrics across multiple threads.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates per-thread metrics with new task metrics and writes aggregated data to a triple buffer.

methods.name: update_metrics
methods.description: Aggregates new task metrics into stored metrics, updating counts and latencies.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Aggregates metrics from all threads, computes statistics, and returns a comprehensive report.
